seasons-and-flow.climate: Wettest: March, April and May. Driest: August, September and October. Hottest: March (27.6°C average). Coolest: August (25.9°C average). Country-wide averages for 1991 to 2020; coasts, mountains and the far north or south can differ a lot.

laws.rule: Cocos (Keeling) Islands is an Australian external territory: Commonwealth laws apply unless excluded, and Western Australian laws apply as 'applied laws' unless an Ordinance repeals, suspends or modifies them. No consolidated list of applied laws is published, so check WA law and the territory's Applied Laws Ordinance for a specific rule.

visa-preparation.entry_summary: Australian citizens and residents need no passport or visa from the mainland, but every passenger must show photo ID; travellers arriving from outside Australia follow normal Australian immigration rules.

steps.step: Carry photo ID such as a driver licence or passport for every traveller.
